svg.title: Factory network – core, distribution ring, cell rings, DMZ, Wi-Fi, VLANs and IP subnets
svg.text: Factory network – IT / DMZ / OT core / fibre backbone ring / cell rings (VLAN = 2nd byte of the IP: 10.<VLAN>.0.<host>)
→ only to the DMZ, never to OT
jump host (MFA, session recording) – no flow passes through
gateway .1 of every OT VLAN; rules FW-01 … FW-99 (11.7, 31.3)
digital twin .102 · HMI clients · eng. station
cell ring 100 Mbit/s copper, MRP ≤ 200 ms

VLAN 54 trunked from D1 and D4
fibre backbone ring 1 Gbit/s, OS2 single-mode, ≈ 450 m (MRP or HSR) – 1000BASE-LX SFPs (link budget 18.4)
Host ranges (doc 15): .1 gateway · .2–.9 switches/APs · .10–.49 PLCs · .50–.99 CNC/robots/AGVs · .100–.149 HMIs/servers · .150–.199 I/O, meters
PROFINET RT stays inside each cell VLAN (not routed). Twin PLC page uses 192.168.10.x – the real plan keeps the host number (21.2).
